content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization issue; authorization is not required, and no claim-data error is identified. A formal appeal is available and has a better similar-claim payment rate than peer-to-peer review (2/4 versus 5/14), while an unchanged submission would not address the denial. Appeal to support separate payment before exhausting the primary-payer path; the patient has no contractual share to bill.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
